text:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v3.3.0 -> 10% ap-south (commit d4c9a11)
deploy-bot: release-notes: https://ci.redwood/release/3.3.0 ; highlights: batching heuristic refactor, kv-cache ttl opt
maya: within first minute ap-south 95p jumped ~180ms, small bump in 5xx rates
ethan: traces show repeated cache-miss patterns + one host reporting higher GC pause times
ops-bot: alert: ap-south-infer-07 OOM-signal (reclaimed) at 4387654326
reena: recommend immediate regional pause and pin back to v3.2.9. keep other regions at rollout percent
zack: agree. regional pin is low-impact and buys time for a hotfix. no global rollback unless other regions degrade
ethan: can we flip routing fast? what's downtime/profile?
maya: routing flip is hot, ~30s to re-route active connections, no infra restarts needed
ops-bot: suggested commands:
```
redwood rollout set --commit d4c9a11 --region ap-south --percent 0 --reason "pause: tail latency + OOM"
redwood route set --region ap-south --from v3.3.0 --to v3.2.9 --force
```
deploy-bot: executed at 4387654330. v3.3.0 traffic ap-south -> 0%
reena: metrics: 95p and p99 trending back to baseline in ~25s, 5xx trending down :thumbsup:
e than: capturing replay set for debug: s3://canary-replays/4387654321/ap-south-tail.tar.gz
zack: follow-ups: add a smoke test with long-tail sequences to CI, and add kv-cache stress test to the small-bake checklist
reena: i'll own the hotfix PR and coordinate a constrained small-bake after patch
deploy-bot: release-notes updated: "ap-south partial rollout paused and region pinned pending kv/batching fix"
maya: decision: regional pause + pin. reopen if other regions surface issues. thanks all.
